build_ResBlock: build a ResBlock residual block for ADM diffusion models with conditional embedding support
create_adm_res_block: create an ADM residual block with automatic skip conv when input and output channels differ
create_adm_res_downsample_block: create an ADM residual block with AvgPool2d downsampling for diffusion model encoder stages
create_adm_res_upsample_block: create an ADM residual block with nearest-neighbor upsampling for diffusion model decoder stages
build_adm_cond_proj: build a conditional projection module with SiLU activation and linear layer for diffusion conditioning
